recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.getByName/d ; /signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i app/build.gradle.kts
./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
git clone -b v0.3.0 https://github.com/obfusk/reproducible-apk-tools.git
OUT="app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk"
reproducible-apk-tools/inplace-fix.py --internal --page-size 16 fix-newlines "$OUT" 'assets/template.html' 'assets/prism/prism-theme-*.css'
mv $OUT /outputs/unsigned.apk
